title: Orchard subscription renewals
bodyMd:
The three subscription plans have different numbers of eligible accounts. The figures count accounts, not fruit boxes.

| Category | Eligible accounts | Renewed accounts |
|---|---:|---:|
| Small | 100 | 65 |
| Standard | 200 | 150 |
| Family | 300 | 210 |
